calls.title: Walentin Widgren and Jake Heier
calls.summary: Walentin Widgren (customer) and Jake Heier with GrowthBook Dorn (GrowthBook team) discussed integrating GrowthBook with Google Analytics via BigQuery, clarifying the need for a sync from Google Analytics to BigQuery before GrowthBook can read the data. Pain points included an unclear setup process and a pending security/legal approval for connecting to BigQuery, with self-hosting on GCP being considered to simplify approval. Next steps: Walentin will decide on self-hosting and update the team via Slack, while the GrowthBook team will provide a new license key if needed.
